runtime: Miniflare 5.20261006.1-alpha / workerd with real SQLite Durable Objects
scope: Local verification; no remote deployment or live investor data
testFixtures: SQL inspection, controlled fixture clock and one held actual SHA-256 exist only in tests/fixtures/durable-worker.js

checks.name: SQLite Durable Object sessions have opaque HttpOnly cookies and isolate visitors
the Worker preserves static asset responses and adds document security headers
revision CAS rejects stale concurrent writes and expired sessions
preview binds exact files and revision; rejected imports are atomic; duplicates are idempotent
write guards reject cross origin, unknown fields, wrong content type and actual oversized bytes
current reviewed revision is required before JSON or ledger exports
reviewed ledger output neutralizes hostile cells and preserves quoted commas and newlines
SQLite Durable Object rate limits cap session creation per IP and requests per session
amount parsing preserves exact precision across supported currency exponents
rejects malformed, negative, ambiguous, grouped, exponent and overflowing money
three seed deals explain exact funding blockers, without treating readiness as closing
queue prioritises target date, then severity, then ID and carries source evidence
sample batch previews explicit additions and imports atomically at one revision
entire CSV batch rejects atomically, even when an earlier row was valid
CSV parser accepts quoted fields/BOM/CRLF and rejects broken schemas and quoting
CSV input uses exact known fictional investors and rejects real or unknown identities
synthetic identifier namespaces reject personal-text suffixes and mismatched deal IDs
commitment amount updates are supported while existing identity reassignment is rejected
stable event IDs are idempotent; changed canonical events are rejected
unassigned receipt retains original canonical identity after explicit matching and reupload
different IDs sharing bank reference+currency+amount stay quarantined until explicit exclusion
same reference with different amounts does not create an inferred duplicate
duplicate reference groups span the synthetic session and block each affected deal
wrong-currency receipts remain blocked and never convert or fund an account
refunds and reversals reduce only their linked parent cash account, independent of row order
adjustments reject missing/adjustment/cross-deal/cross-currency parents and aggregate excess
parent quarantine also quarantines adjustments and parent with adjustments cannot be excluded
fees use half-up basis points and deterministic largest-remainder investor allocations
fee payer change moves obligations and exposes seeded lead cash rather than silently reallocating it
one minor-unit under/overpayment remains a blocker with no tolerance or floating-point drift
aggregate cash and obligations reject overflow before state is committed
duplicate resolution that activates overflowing cash is rejected atomically
metadata and attestations accept only explicit synthetic schema and known actors
full Aurora route imports, matches, attaches metadata, reviews and exports exact current hash
review requires readiness, an explicit current request, known reviewer and confirmation
hash canonicalises object keys/array order and excludes audit and review fields
export hash binds the exact raw snapshot and calculated fees, allocations and cash accounts
any successful mutation invalidates all reviews and old export approval
exact idempotent reimport preserves approved state and revision, while new import invalidates it
stale preview and stale revision mutations reject without input changes; reset is monotonic
tampered review revision/hash never authorises export or approval
shared limits reject byte/row amplification and accumulated commitments/events/audit
two independent HTTP clients sharing a cookie can commit a revision exactly once
different visitors write independently into separate real SQLite objects
disposing and recreating Miniflare preserves state, audit, approved review and exact export hash
expired session cookies fail closed and a subsequent explicit session gets a new identity
session alarms delete expired SQL state and rate counters without an incoming API request
invalid CSV and mismatched previews leave every persisted state byte unchanged
intervening mutations reject stale approval and clear the requested review
SQLite rate counters expire and alarm cleanup preserves live windows
rejected writes consume durable limits and cannot reset them by restarting workerd
an export held during real SHA-256 rejects a concurrently changed reviewed revision
a preview held during real SHA-256 rejects a concurrently changed revision
review approval and reviewed export held during SHA-256 fail closed if SQL expiry passes
valid-shaped unknown cookies never seed sessions or leave SQLite schema behind
a duplicate import held during SHA-256 cannot overwrite an intervening successful write
returned and thrown Durable Object storage failures produce only a safe 503 response
malformed session creation requests consume the persistent per-IP attempt limit
malformed existing-session requests consume its persisted request limit without changing state
a real SQLite update failure rolls back state and returns a safe 503 without a fallback write
the public Worker never exposes internal Durable Object or test fixture routes
